definition: Great-circle distance from the Argo position to the nearest RTOFS native grid-cell centre.
computation: KD-tree on unit-sphere coordinates for the 8 nearest cells; chord c converted to arc 6371 * 2 asin(c/2); the smallest of the 8 is kept. Bounded by half the cell diagonal.

All remaining months.

definition: RTOFS Tropical Cyclone Heat Potential at the profile position: heat above the 26 C isotherm.
computation: Daily field: TCHP = 1e-7 * sum over HYCOM layers above D26 of rho * cp * max(T - 26, 0) * dz_eff, with rho = gsw.rho_t_exact(SA, T, p) and cp = gsw.cp_t_exact(SA, T, p) (TEOS-10), layer thickness = HYCOM thickness (Pa) / 9806, dz_eff the full layer if it lies above D26 or the part above D26 if it straddles it. Source: rtofs_glo.t00z.f06.archv (00Z cycle, 6-h forecast). Then sampled to the Argo position by inverse-distance-squared weighting over the 8 nearest RTOFS grid cells: F = sum(w_i F_i) / sum(w_i), w_i = 1/d_i^2, missing neighbours excluded. NaN where the column never reaches 26 C.

definition: RTOFS depth of the 26 C isotherm at the profile position.
computation: Daily field: first HYCOM layer (from the surface) with T <= 26 C, linearly interpolated between that layer's centre depth and the one above: D26 = z1 + (T1 - 26)/(T1 - T2) * (z2 - z1). Requires the top layer to be >= 26 C. Then sampled to the Argo position by inverse-distance-squared weighting over the 8 nearest RTOFS grid cells: F = sum(w_i F_i) / sum(w_i), w_i = 1/d_i^2, missing neighbours excluded.

definition: RTOFS sea-surface height.
computation: Variable `ssh` in rtofs_glo_2ds_f006_diag.nc (00Z, 6-h forecast); sampled to the Argo position by inverse-distance-squared weighting over the 8 nearest RTOFS grid cells: F = sum(w_i F_i) / sum(w_i), w_i = 1/d_i^2, missing neighbours excluded.

definition: RTOFS mixed-layer thickness (HYCOM's own diagnostic).
computation: Variable `mixed_layer_thickness` in the 2D diagnostic file; sampled to the Argo position by inverse-distance-squared weighting over the 8 nearest RTOFS grid cells: F = sum(w_i F_i) / sum(w_i), w_i = 1/d_i^2, missing neighbours excluded.

definition: RTOFS surface boundary-layer thickness (HYCOM's own diagnostic).
computation: Variable `surface_boundary_layer_thickness` in the 2D diagnostic file; sampled to the Argo position by inverse-distance-squared weighting over the 8 nearest RTOFS grid cells: F = sum(w_i F_i) / sum(w_i), w_i = 1/d_i^2, missing neighbours excluded.

definition: T_s - 26, where T_s is RTOFS surface temperature.
computation: T_s = top-layer temperature from the daily TCHP field (`surface_temp_c`), sampled to the Argo position by inverse-distance-squared weighting over the 8 nearest RTOFS grid cells: F = sum(w_i F_i) / sum(w_i), w_i = 1/d_i^2, missing neighbours excluded; then `surf_t - 26.0`. Negative means the surface is below 26 C.

definition: model_interp_d26_m - model_mixed_layer_thickness_m.
computation: Thickness of the warm layer below the mixed layer. Negative if D26 lies inside the mixed layer.

definition: model_interp_d26_m / model_surface_boundary_layer_thickness_m.
computation: How many boundary-layer depths the 26 C isotherm sits below the surface.

definition: model_ssh_m * |lat|.
computation: Lets a single split act differently by latitude.

definition: model_mixed_layer_thickness_m * |lat|.
computation: As above.

definition: model_temp_excess_26c * |lat|.
computation: As above.

definition: Standard deviation of RTOFS TCHP within about 1 degree of the profile.
computation: Population std (ddof=0) of valid cells, h = 12 cells (~2 x 2 degree box); from the daily RTOFS field at the nearest grid cell (y0, x0); square window |y - y0| <= h, |x - x0| <= h cells on the native 1/12-degree grid (longitude wraps); valid (finite) cells only, and NaN unless valid cells cover >= 25% of the window.

definition: Standard deviation of RTOFS TCHP within about 2 degrees of the profile.
computation: As the 1-degree version with h = 25 cells (~4 x 4 degree box); from the daily RTOFS field at the nearest grid cell (y0, x0); square window |y - y0| <= h, |x - x0| <= h cells on the native 1/12-degree grid (longitude wraps); valid (finite) cells only, and NaN unless valid cells cover >= 25% of the window.

definition: Magnitude of the horizontal gradient of RTOFS TCHP.
computation: 100 * sqrt(((F[y0,x0+1] - F[y0,x0-1]) / (2 dx))^2 + ((F[y0+1,x0] - F[y0-1,x0]) / (2 dy))^2), centred differences at the nearest grid cell, dx and dy the local grid spacings in km (dx shrinks with cos lat). NaN if any of the four neighbours is missing.

definition: How much RTOFS TCHP at the profile's grid cell departs from its own 1-degree neighbourhood mean.
computation: F[y0, x0] - mean of valid cells in the h = 12 window; from the daily RTOFS field at the nearest grid cell (y0, x0); square window |y - y0| <= h, |x - x0| <= h cells on the native 1/12-degree grid (longitude wraps); valid (finite) cells only, and NaN unless valid cells cover >= 25% of the window. Uses the nearest-cell value, not the interpolated one. Biased near the 26 C edge because sub-threshold cells are excluded rather than counted as zero.

definition: Magnitude of the horizontal gradient of RTOFS D26.
computation: 100 * sqrt(((F[y0,x0+1] - F[y0,x0-1]) / (2 dx))^2 + ((F[y0+1,x0] - F[y0-1,x0]) / (2 dy))^2), centred differences at the nearest grid cell, dx and dy the local grid spacings in km (dx shrinks with cos lat). NaN if any of the four neighbours is missing.

definition: Steric height of the 1000-2000 dbar layer of the RTOFS water column.
computation: [dyn(0; p_ref=2000) - dyn(0; p_ref=1000)] / g with dyn = gsw.geo_strf_dyn_height at the surface, g = 9.81, from the RTOFS T/S profile interpolated to the Argo point (NaN-safe inverse-distance weighting). Requires the profile to reach 2000 dbar. Available on ~11% of rows (77 processed dates). The ~2% of negative values are all in the Mediterranean (33-44 N, 2-35 E): its deep water is so salty that at 1000-2000 dbar it is denser than the reference water despite being warm, so the specific-volume anomaly and hence the steric height are negative. Physical, not an error.

definition: Maximum buoyancy frequency squared in the upper 200 m of RTOFS.
computation: max of gsw.Nsquared(SA, CT, p, lat) over layer mid-points shallower than 200 m. ~11% coverage.

definition: Mean buoyancy frequency squared between the surface and RTOFS D26.
computation: mean of gsw.Nsquared over mid-points shallower than model D26. ~11% coverage.
